notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone :)

Update 1.2 content :
- Texture Optimization : Use less graphics card memory.
- The houses interior are less dark : More easy to navigate.
- All the hardware loot system has been revamp and balanced.

notes.title: Update 1.16
notes.content:
Hello everyone a New Update 1.16 is now available

* New :  I added an automatic tracking camera to the cars
* Fixed : I fixed a collision bug between the cars and the crates giving too much damage

notes.title: Update 1.154
notes.content:
Hello everyone a New Update 1.154 is now available

* Fixed :  The video settings problem where the system set automatically to LOW
* Fixed : I removed the resolution scale option causing problems

notes.title: Update 1.153
notes.content:
Hello everyone a New Update 1.153 is now available

* Fixed : Removed the crouch button in the bindings menu
* Fixed : Some translation issues
* Fixed : A bug that prevent to receive some achievements

notes.title: Update 1.152 Quick Fix
notes.content: Quick fix for the knife bug not killing zombies.

notes.title: Update 1.151
notes.content:
Hello everyone a New Update 1.151 is now available

* Fixed : The key bindings problem with the axis character and car, now you can bind both the same key

notes.title: Update 1.15
notes.content:
Hello everyone a New Update 1.15 is now available

* Many fix on the cars and zombies physics
* The physics of cars are more accurate with the zombies impact
* Physics has been personalized for each vehicle
* Fixed zombies doing big damage on cars
* Fixed zombies giving damage between them
* Fixed the knife attack not working near the car
* Fixed the garages floor physics material
* Fixed some text in the french version

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.content:
Hello everyone a New Update 1.14 is now available

* Achievements has been added
* Some translation text button has been fixed
* Some collision at the garage has been fixed

notes.title: Update 1.13
notes.content:
Hello everyone a New Update 1.13 is now available

* New physics system between the cars and the zombies to prevent the bug where the cars are stop by zombies
* Another fix for the flamethrower bug where it goes to 0 in a second
* A new menu where you can see all cars to unlock
* The police pickup and the red sedan has been switch from level
* The engine and transmission of the red sedan has been upgraded to be more fast
* The text of the story has been align for all language

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.content:
Hello everyone a New Update 1.12 is now available

* Pickable item give 15 hardware instead of 5
* Crate hit give 2 hardware instead of 1
* The fuel consumption of the stationary car has been reduced by 5x
* The arcade game give 25 hardware for 500 point instead of 10 hardware for 1000 point 
* Fixed bug car collision
* Fixed bug with flame thrower
